subject: Bridge MAP: handover playbook for eval assets (dataset + prompt pack)
messages:
From: Kate Long <kate.long@indigo-retail.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Indigo Retail Legal <legal@indigo-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bridge MAP: dataset & prompt pack exchange / next steps

Hi Mateo & Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Indigo is excited to run a focused eval. Legal asked me to capture a quick mutual action plan so we can get the assets exchanged without surprises. High level asks from our side:

- Scope: we need the sample dataset (anonymized product Q&A snippets) + the prompt pack (50 canonical prompts + expected outputs) for a 2-week sandbox.
- Usage constraints: assets will be used only in a closed sandbox environment (no production inference), retention capped at 30 days post-eval, and no redistribution outside of Indigo.
- Acceptance criteria: we’ll run 5 representative prompt slices and provide pass/fail with examples; we want to lock acceptance gating to the MAP.
- Timeline: target handoff the week of Aug 17, with a 2-week evaluation window; go/no-go decision by Sep 1.

Can you confirm Redwood’s standard handover playbook here and whether you can accept the 30-day retention restriction? Also please attach the MPA draft and a stub list of files you’ll deliver so our legal can review.

Thanks — happy to sync if easier.

—Kate
Kate Long
Head of ML Platforms, Indigo Retail
kate.long@indigo-retail.com

Attachments: (none in this message)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Long <kate.long@indigo-retail.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge MAP: dataset & prompt pack exchange / next steps

Hi Kate — thanks for the clear bullets. We can absolutely run a handoff that respects the sandbox-only and 30-day retention constraints; that matches our standard ephemeral-provisioning lane with a short-form MPA. Quick summary of what Redwood will do: 

- Deliverables: anonymized sample dataset (csv manifest + zipped snippets), prompt pack (json + markdown guidance), and an evaluation checklist with the 5 representative slices you mentioned.
- Access model: ephemeral S3 share + one-time presigned download for dataset; prompt pack will also be available via a gated Drive link.
- Retention & takedown: Redwood will automatically flag the assets for deletion 30 days after the final download + will provide a deletion certificate.
- Escrow option: if Indigo requires escrowed custody of the original corpus, we can put a copy in our verified escrow bucket and provide audit logs; escrow increases lead time by ~3 business days.
- Legal: attached is a short MPA draft (indigo_mpa_draft_v1.pdf) capturing the SLAs, acceptance gates, and usage covenants.

Proposed timeline:
- Aug 12: Redwood sends MPA + asset manifest (attached).
- Aug 17: asset handoff window opens (we’ll provide presigned link + Drive access).
- Aug 17 - Aug 31: Indigo evaluation window (2 weeks).
- Sep 1: decision meeting; if accepted, we pick next steps for pilot scale.

If that looks good, can you confirm Indigo’s signatory and whether legal prefers DocuSign or an exchanged-signed PDF? I’ll mark the ticket in HubSpot (DEAL-4729) and coordinate the handoff runbook.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: indigo_mpa_draft_v1.pdf, dataset_manifest_excerpt.csv
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Long <kate.long@indigo-retail.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bridge MAP: dataset & prompt pack exchange / next steps

Adding a couple legal/ops clarifications so we have a clean MAP to send to Indigo: 

Mateo — suggested edits to the draft MPA (see inline notes in indigo_mpa_draft_v1.pdf):
- Clause 3.1 (Usage): make explicit "sandbox-only, no production inference, no model tuning on the raw samples" — this prevents accidental fine-tuning leakage.
- Clause 4.2 (Retention): acceptance of 30 days ok but require a deletion certificate and a short activity log showing last-download timestamps.
- Clause 5.4 (Escrow): escrow copy may be allowed only if Indigo signs a limited-use addendum (we should include a one-paragraph addendum that restricts escrowed copy to audit only).
- Clause 7 (Liability): keep mutual indemnities limited for this ephemeral exchange; our standard one-page liability cap is sufficient.

Operational runbook notes:
- We should produce a manifest with SHA256 checksums for every file — include that in dataset_manifest_excerpt.csv.
- If escrow requested, mark handoff target for Aug 20 to allow time for escrow ingestion.
- Prepare a brief teardown script we can run after 30 days to generate the deletion certificate.

Marissa — can you confirm ops can generate the deletion certificate & SHA256 manifest? I’ll prep the limited-use escrow addendum for Kate’s legal.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Product Counsel, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

(Inline attachments referenced: indigo_mpa_draft_v1.pdf - annotated)

Subject: Re: Bridge MAP: handover playbook for eval assets (dataset + prompt pack)

Thanks — this looks reasonable and appreciates the level of detail. Indigo legal can accept the 30-day retention with the deletion certificate and the limited-use escrow addendum. Two quick confirmations: 

1) Signatory: I’m the authorized signatory for the evaluation MAP; DocuSign is preferred. Please send the envelope to kate.long@indigo-retail.com.
2) Deliverable list: can you confirm the final deliverable file list will include the prompt pack (promptpack_v2.json), dataset excerpt (product_qa_snippets_2026-06.zip), manifest with SHA256, and the 5-slice evaluation checklist?

If you can send the DocuSign link and final manifest by EOD Aug 17, we’ll plan the handoff for Aug 18 and kickoff the sandbox on Aug 19.

Appreciate the responsiveness — looking forward to the run.

Best,
—Kate
